claims.claim: 速效救心丸由川芎嗪（tetramethylpyrazine）与冰片（borneol）组成，批准文号为国药准字Z12020025，每丸重 40 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: SJP is composed of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol approval number Z12020025 of the China State Food and Drug Administration [SFDA]). … Each pill weighs 40 mg.
claims.applicability: 直接：为已发表试验方案对本品成分、批准文号与规格的记载，与说明书索引件一致。
claims.uncertainty: 试验方案为二手转述批准文号与规格；说明书现行官方文本未获核验。

claims.claim: 本品功能为理气活血，可增加冠脉血流量、改善心肌细胞缺氧、缓解心绞痛，作用与硝酸甘油相似。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: it has the effect of regulating Qi and promoting blood circulation. SJP can increase coronary blood flow, improve myocardial cell hypoxia, and relieve angina pectoris similar to nitroglycerin
claims.applicability: 直接：功能主治的药理表述，属治疗作用描述，不构成对预防性持有的覆盖。
claims.uncertainty: 机制表述来自试验方案引言，非监管原文。

claims.claim: 本品随机对照试验纳入 324 例慢性稳定型心绞痛（气滞血瘀证）患者，纳入标准要求确诊冠心病。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome).
claims.applicability: 直接：显示疗效证据的纳入对象均为已确诊冠心病、气滞血瘀证人群。
claims.uncertainty: 为试验方案，结果未报告；人群限定为已确诊者。

claims.claim: 本品治疗心绞痛的既有证据因纳入研究方法学质量差而薄弱。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: However, the evidence remains weak due to the poor methodological quality of included studies [ 7 ].
claims.applicability: 直接：方案作者对既有证据（含 Cochrane 系统评价）的质量判断。
claims.uncertainty: 为二手转述的系统评价结论，未直接核验 Cochrane 全文。

claims.claim: 纳入 41 项试验、6276 人的荟萃分析被转述为按 Jadad 评分多数研究质量低。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: A systematic review including 41 trials involving 6276 participants was included in the analysis.
claims.applicability: 直接：疗效证据体规模与质量的描述。
claims.uncertainty: 荟萃分析本身未获全文，数字经试验方案转述。

claims.claim: 中国急性心肌梗死登记（CCC-ACS）纳入 33,386 例急性心肌梗死患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-hospital delay in patients with acute myocardial infarction in China: findings from the Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Acute Coronary Syndrome (CCC-ACS) project
claims.supportQuote: Data were collected from November 2014 to December 2019 as part of the Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Acute Coronary Syndrome (CCC-ACS) project. A total of 33,386 patients with AMI admitted to the index hospitals were included in this study.
claims.applicability: 直接：中国人群、全国性登记的院前延迟分母。
claims.uncertainty: 登记仅纳入住院患者，院外死亡者未计入。

claims.claim: 该登记院前延迟中位 3.3 小时，70.7% 的患者在症状出现 ≥2 小时后到院，30.2% 超过 6 小时。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-hospital delay in patients with acute myocardial infarction in China: findings from the Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Acute Coronary Syndrome (CCC-ACS) project
claims.supportQuote: The median pre-hospital delay of patients with AMI was 3.3 (1.6–7.0) h. … Overall, 70.7% of patients with AMI arrived at hospital ≥ 2 h after symptom onset … and 30.2% of patients with AMI presented for medical care more than 6 h after symptom onset
claims.applicability: 直接：中国 AMI 人群就医延迟的定量分布。
claims.uncertainty: 症状起始时间由患者自报，存在回忆误差。

claims.claim: 该登记中 >80% 的患者未呼叫急救救护车。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-hospital delay in patients with acute myocardial infarction in China: findings from the Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Acute Coronary Syndrome (CCC-ACS) project
claims.supportQuote: more than 80% of patients in this analysis avoided calling for an emergency ambulance
claims.applicability: 直接：院前急救转运使用率的测量，说明自我处置而非呼叫急救较普遍。

claims.claim: 许多患者最初未识别心肌梗死症状、将症状错误归因于其他原因，从而延长决策延迟。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-hospital delay in patients with acute myocardial infarction in China: findings from the Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Acute Coronary Syndrome (CCC-ACS) project
claims.supportQuote: Many patients initially fail to recognize myocardial infarction symptoms and misattribute their symptoms to other causes, which may lead to a longer decision delay.
claims.applicability: 直接：症状错误归因与延迟的关联，支持缓解现象不用于自行排除病因的实践边界。
claims.uncertainty: 作者对该关联的叙述性解释，非因果估计。

claims.claim: STEMI 患者院前延迟 ≥2 小时与院内死亡风险升高相关（OR 1.36，95%CI 1.09–1.69）。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-hospital delay in patients with acute myocardial infarction in China: findings from the Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Acute Coronary Syndrome (CCC-ACS) project
claims.supportQuote: A pre-hospital delay of ≥ 2 h was associated with an increased risk of mortality [odds ratio (OR) = 1.36, 95% CI: 1.09–1.69, P = 0.006] and major adverse cardiovascular events (OR = 1.22, 95% CI: 1.02–1.47, P = 0.033) in patients with STEMI
claims.applicability: 直接：延迟与不良结局的定量关联，用于说明自行观察的代价。
claims.uncertainty: 观察性登记，多变量校正后仍可能存在残余混杂。

claims.claim: 儿童急性中毒的登记研究显示 90.4% 发生在家中，药物为仅次于农药的常见毒物（275 例，25.6%），误服为最主要原因（755 例，70.2%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Characterization of Acute Poisoning in Hospitalized Children in Southwest China
claims.supportQuote: A total of 1,076 acute poisoning cases among hospitalized children admitted to Children’s Hospital of Chongqing Medical University from January 2012 to December 2020 were included in this study. … Poisoning usually occurred at home (973 cases, 90.4%). Pesticides (381 cases, 35.4%) and drugs (275 cases, 25.6%) were the two most common poisonous substances. Two main causes of poisoning were accidental taking (755 cases, 70.2%)
claims.applicability: 间接：中国西南地区住院儿童登记，家庭药箱儿童误服的相邻场景证据。
claims.uncertainty: 为跨药品类别研究，未单独列出本品；医院住院病例，非全人群发生率。

claims.claim: 儿童药物中毒以精神类、心血管类与感冒药为主。
claims.sourceTitle: Characterization of Acute Poisoning in Hospitalized Children in Southwest China
claims.supportQuote: drug poisoning was predominantly caused by psychotropic, cardiovascular, and cold medicines.
claims.applicability: 间接：儿童误服药物类别构成，心血管类药物在列。
claims.uncertainty: 未单独列出速效救心丸。

claims.claim: 横断面研究显示 62.4% 的家庭贮存未用或过期药品。
claims.sourceTitle: Household storage and disposal of unused and expired medicines in Dessie, Ethiopia: a cross-sectional study
claims.supportQuote: The study found that 62.4% of households stored unused or expired medicines, with analgesics, antibiotics, and cold and flu drugs being the most commonly used.
claims.applicability: 间接：家庭存药普遍性的横断面测量，埃塞俄比亚样本。
claims.uncertainty: 样本为中国以外的中低收入国家，外推至中国城市家庭受限制。

claims.claim: 家庭贮存未用/过期药品的最常见理由为“以备将来使用”（90%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Household storage and disposal of unused and expired medicines in Dessie, Ethiopia: a cross-sectional study
claims.supportQuote: The most frequently reported reasons for having unused and expired medicines stored at homes were for future use 284 (90%), discontinuation of medication 219 (69.7%), and to give others if needed 115 (36.6%).
claims.applicability: 间接：与养生情境下“以备不时之需”的囤药动机一致，外推受地区限制。

claims.claim: 家庭贮存未用/过期药品的风险包括儿童误服与过量。
claims.sourceTitle: Household storage and disposal of unused and expired medicines in Dessie, Ethiopia: a cross-sectional study
claims.supportQuote: The storage of unused or expired medicines in households carries several risks, including drug resistance, diversion for initial use, accidental ingestion by children, and overdose, especially during emergencies.
claims.applicability: 直接支持“家庭囤药存在儿童误服与过量风险”这一风险定性；发生率属跨类别数据。
claims.uncertainty: 风险定性陈述，未给出本品专属发生率。

claims.claim: 胸痛持续不缓解，或伴出汗、恶心、头晕、气短，可能为心肌梗死，应立即呼叫急救（英国 NHS 为 999，中国为 120）并接受医院即刻治疗。
claims.supportQuote: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath. You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 直接：患者面向的胸痛急救行动边界，急救号码本地化为 120。
claims.uncertainty: 英国公共卫生来源，急救号码在本地语境为 120。

claims.claim: 以 33,386 例与登记报告的 70.7% 院前延迟 ≥2 小时比例计算，约 23,604 例在症状出现 2 小时后到院；以 >80% 未呼叫救护车计算，约 26,709 例未使用急救转运。
claims.assumptions: 以登记报告的百分比作为点估计，假定其适用于全部 33,386 例；未呼叫救护车比例取 >80% 的下界 80%。
claims.sensitivity: 70.7% 与 >80% 均为登记自报比例，含回忆与抽样误差；将 >80% 取下界 80%，实际未呼叫救护车例数更多，故两数均为下限估计。
claims.applicability: 用于说明“含服后自行观察”这一处置路径所对应的已测量延迟规模，属数量级估计。
claims.uncertainty: 该登记未测量含服行为，此推导不构成“含服导致延迟”的因果结论。

claims.claim: 本品疗效证据集中于已确诊冠心病心绞痛（气滞血瘀证）人群，未检索到以无冠心病诊断者为对象、以本品为干预或暴露的研究；而中国急性心肌梗死人群的就医延迟普遍。两条证据线分别支撑“治疗性使用”与“延迟风险”，均不覆盖无诊断者的预防性持有。
claims.applicability: 综合两条独立证据线，界定“持有获益”与“使用获益”各自可达到的结论边界。
claims.uncertainty: 该综合未包含对无诊断人群直接研究的检索命中的正面证据；“未检索到”是对检索范围的陈述，不等于该研究不存在。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
supportingSources.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome).

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Pre-hospital delay in patients with acute myocardial infarction in China: findings from the Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Acute Coronary Syndrome (CCC-ACS) project
supportingSources.supportQuote: Many patients initially fail to recognize myocardial infarction symptoms and misattribute their symptoms to other causes, which may lead to a longer decision delay.

claims.claim: 心脏性猝死常为冠心病的首发临床表现，相当比例的病例发生于被判定为低风险者。
claims.sourceTitle: Sudden cardiac death in stable coronary artery disease: A literature review
claims.supportQuote: Contemporary data reveal that SCD often represents the first clinical manifestation of coronary heart disease, with a substantial proportion of cases occurring in individuals classified as low risk.
claims.applicability: 直接：综述对冠心病首发表现为心脏性猝死的表述，用于说明无诊断高危者的首发事件可为猝死。
claims.uncertainty: 为综述的叙述性流行病学陈述，非原始队列数据。
